Since 0.1.11. The major version stays 0.

### Moonlight
Settings › Plugins lists an installed plugin. Share paired computers lets it see the computers Foldcade paired, stream the games you start in Foldcade, and quit games on them. The pairing key stays in Foldcade. Use for Moonlight games comes on with that share, and only the plugin you shared or turned on most recently has it on (#402).

A game on a computer Foldcade paired with itself then opens in that plugin, across both screens. Foldcade starts it on the top screen and gives it both. With the switch off, or with no plugin, the game still opens in Moonlight. A computer paired only in Moonlight still opens there. A Foldcade-paired game can open in the plugin even when Moonlight is not installed. When the plugin finishes, Home returns on both screens (#402).

That share stays on this device. A backup or a transfer does not carry it. A plugin whose signature changes starts with the share off (#402).

### Plugins
Settings › Plugins can install Foldcade Moonlight from its latest release, and update one that is already there. Foldcade checks when it starts, and again when you open the plugin's page, unless a check ran in the last 10 minutes. Check for updates always checks. Install and Update wait until you choose them, and Android asks you to confirm (#403).

When the release notes include its version, the page can say Update available and that version, or Up to date, before it downloads anything. A release that leaves its version out reads Latest release until the file is downloaded. The file it installs still has to be Foldcade Moonlight, newer than what is installed, and signed with Foldcade's release key. A file that fails that check is not installed. With no release to install, the row says Not available yet (#403).

If Android has not allowed Foldcade to install apps, the row says Allow installs and opens that setting. Once you allow it and come back, the row clears (#403).

A plugin installed some other way is listed the same way, and it still needs Share paired computers (#402).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
- A plugin download says Downloading… and does not show a percent (#403).
- The name under a Settings › Plugins tile is one line, so a long name is cut off. A release build and a debug build of the same plugin can look the same on that shelf. The plugin's page shows its package (#403).
